ability.name: Audit LSA Protection State
ability.description: Checks registry settings to verify if LSA Protection (RunAsPPL) is configured to prevent unauthorized LSASS reading.

stages.command_template: $d='C:\Windows\Temp\bas'; if(!(Test-Path $d)){New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force $d|Out-Null}; $(try { $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; Get-ItemProperty -Path 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\Lsa' -Name 'RunAsPPL' } catch { "ERROR: LSA Protection key check failed or not set - $_" }) | Tee-Object -FilePath $d\out.txt

rationale: Auditing the configuration of LSA Protection is the recommended, non-disruptive method to evaluate host resilience against memory dumping techniques.
